text.zh: 一步步用 MCSL 2 开服器在 Windows 上搭 Minecraft 服务器：下载解压、新建服务器（以 Purpur 1.21.1、内存 1–4 GB、Java 21 为例）、启动并同意 EULA，再用 127.0.0.1:25565 连进去。文中附有核心版本与 Java 版本的对照表，最后介绍怎样用 Sakura Frp 之类的内网穿透让朋友也能加入。
text.en: A step-by-step guide to running a Minecraft server on Windows with the MCSL 2 launcher: download and unzip it, create a server (the example uses Purpur 1.21.1, 1–4 GB of memory and Java 21), start it, accept the EULA and join at 127.0.0.1:25565. It includes a table of which Java version each Minecraft version needs, and ends with tunnelling services such as Sakura Frp so that friends can join too.
